title: Windler Farm, Vicinity of East Forty-eighth Avenue & Picadilly Road, Aurora, Adams County, CO
notes: Significance: The Windler farm is one of the earliest surviving family-owned farms in Adams County, Colorado and is representative of a rapidly disappearing agricultural lifestyle on Colorado's eastern plains.
